message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Four Wild cards and four Wild Draw Four cards. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned when you finish a round by discarding all your cards. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card that matches either the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top discard. Wild cards can be played at any time. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you risk being challenged.) | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw from the draw pile until you get a playable card. If you still cannot play after drawing, your turn ends. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have only one card left, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards remaining in opponents’ hands: Number cards = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20 points, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. The first player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins the game. | --- ### Optional Variations | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | If a player plays a Draw Two or Wild Draw Four, the next player can stack another of the same type instead of drawing. | | **No Wild Draw Four Challenge** | Some groups allow Wild Draw Four to be played regardless of having a matching color. | | **Custom Decks** | Use themed decks (e.g., Uno Attack) with special rules. | | **House Rules** | Many groups add unique twists (e.g., “Draw 5” cards, “Skip 2” cards). | --- **Quick Play Summary** 1. Shuffle & deal 7 cards each. 2. Flip top card to start discard pile. 3. Clockwise play: match color/number/symbol or play Wild. 4. Action cards affect next player. 5. Draw if you can’t play. 6. Say “UNO” on your second‑to‑last card. 7. Finish round when someone discards all cards. 8. Score and continue until someone reaches 500 points. Enjoy your game!
